findings.title: Materials' 51-point lens gap signals earnings cliff
findings.body: Materials trades at 16.21x forward but 32.47x trailing, a 51-point percentile gap — the widest in the table. Analysts are pricing in 100 percent earnings growth, which would be a historic rebound from a depressed base, not a steady-state outlook.

findings.title: Health Care's forward percentile near peak despite compression
findings.body: Health Care's forward P/E sits at the 97th percentile of its five-year range even after a 44 percent multiple compression versus trailing. The market is underwriting 78 percent earnings growth, a bet that margins expand sharply from already-rich levels.

findings.title: Information Technology at all-time cheap forward multiple
findings.body: Information Technology's forward P/E of 16.69 is at percentile 0 — the cheapest it has been in five years — while its trailing multiple sits at percentile 14. The 38 percent compression implies analysts expect 62 percent earnings growth, yet the market is still unwilling to pay up.
